title: VTC Events — Check-in — Ticket Session — Status — payload
description: An event's door staff read where a door session they opened stands: still waiting, the ticket admitted (with the check-in it recorded), refused with a reason, or expired (VTI-EVT-173). The door staff member is the document proof's signer. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

sessionId.description: The session to read, as vtc/events/checkin/ticket-session/start returned it.

TicketSessionState.title: TicketSessionState
TicketSessionState.description: Where a door session stands. `pending`: no wallet has answered. `admitted`: a ticket was presented, verified and used; `checkIn` says what was recorded. `refused`: a presentation arrived and was refused; `refusal` says why. `expired`: the session closed with no answer.

TicketRefusal.title: TicketRefusal
TicketRefusal.description: Why a presented ticket did not admit (VTI-EVT-173). `ticketInvalid`: not a ticket this community or the event's identity issued, its proof or the wallet's key binding does not verify, or it has expired. `ticketRevoked`: its status in the community's shared status set is revoked. `ticketUsed`: it has already admitted its holder. `notGoing`: the registration it names is no longer going. `wrongEvent`: it is a ticket for another event.

Response.title: VTC Events — Check-in — Ticket Session — Status — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/checkin/ticket-session/status/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/checkin/ticket-session/status/0.1#response.

occurrence.description: The occurrence the session is for, where the event is a series (VTI-EVT-195).

checkIn.description: Present exactly when `state` is `admitted`: the check-in the ticket recorded, with `method` `ticket`.
